subject: reasoning
question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are numbered from 1 to 6. Select the number that will be on the face opposite to the one showing '1'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5d10c40d6605d200b9b37384923b765255a0728ffa69e88619466bc5a6ae8445.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/20cdc087013863cc6f14e5f20754514168e836c7da19f6b65df47ef5f8eebce8.png]
solution:
In the given figure: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5d10c40d6605d200b9b37384923b765255a0728ffa69e88619466bc5a6ae8445.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/20cdc087013863cc6f14e5f20754514168e836c7da19f6b65df47ef5f8eebce8.png] 

In a dice a face is surrounded by four sides and the remaining one side is opposite to it.

 
• We can see all four sides around the face '6' which are 2, 3, 4, 5.
 
• The remaining face is '1' which means 6 and 1 are opposite faces.

So the face opposite to 1 is 6.

Hence **the correct answer is 6.**
